conclusion: The ISEV/MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the high-level recommendation for transparent, orthogonal EV characterization, controls to distinguish vesicular from non-vesicular material, and robust reporting of production and functional assays. However, the MISEV document does not provide or verify any program-specific SGL-001 documents or batch/assay records. Therefore the parts of the reviewer conclusions that rely on MISEV as justification for orthogonal QC and assay validation are supported; the parts that assert absence of specific SGL-001 program documents (MCB/WCB records, validated assay reports, GMP-like batch release/stability data, in vivo bridging data) are not verifiable from the allowed evidence.
unsupported_assertions: Assertion that the supplied program evidence includes or does not include SGL-001-specific MCB/WCB documentation (no program-specific bank records are present in the allowed evidence set, but this absence cannot be demonstrated by the MISEV guidance alone).

Assertion that validated orthogonal QC assay validation reports for SGL-001 (including LLOQ, specificity, precision) are missing — the MISEV guidance does not contain program-specific assay validation files and therefore cannot be used to demonstrate their absence.

Assertion that GMP-like batch release and stability data for SGL-001 are missing — MISEV is a consensus guideline and does not supply batch records, so it cannot be used to prove absence of program GMP-like runs or their results.

Assertion that a stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint for SGL-001 is missing — MISEV recommends such assays but does not contain program-specific potency validation or correlation data to demonstrate its absence.

Assertion that controlled cross-species biodistribution or formulation/device compatibility data for SGL-001 are missing — the guideline does not include or exclude program-specific biodistribution or device compatibility studies, so their absence is not established by the allowed evidence.
